items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: We've been more than friends. I went to Britain with Pee Wee; Scotland, England, London, Edinburgh, Stockholm, Sweden, Germany -- we played the German International Jazz Festival... we also rehearsed for four days in Iceland

ctx.x: Tell us about some of those bands up around New England, territory bands. Did you want to get into that or did you want to wait until later?

No, no, that's all right. Previous to this, one of the famous all time territory bands was Mal Hallett, and of course, in between in the middle thirties was Joe Haymes -- he always had a great music organization; he had people with him like Pee Wee Irwin, that's how they
